comments.author: nowherebeen
comments.story: Ask HN: How did Fast get a $580mm valuation?
comments.why: Chamath's view that VC resembles a Ponzi scheme
comments.text: Not really. Just because they exit at a later stage doesn't mean its not a ponzi scheme. Chamath Palihapitiya certainly disagrees with you ( [VIDEO] ). Skyhigh valuations with no product market fit and no path to revenue certainly sounds like one to me. Many startups burn money to acquire customers, but churn is high because they don't have PM fit. It becomes an endless cycle of raising to acquire more customers. Once the money stops, someone will eventually be holding the bag.
